claims.statement: Revert of rule v18 to v17 did not clear the 186 held orders; they remain held and new east-node allocations are also held
claims.limitation: Rule revert was necessary to prevent NEW orders from being allocated with broken timing, but existing held orders need re-allocation to get valid slots.

claims.statement: The 186 held orders from v18 allocation remain stuck because their pickup slots closed during the 47-minute carrier confirmation latency; reverting the rule does not re-open or refresh their closed slots
claims.limitation: Impact requires active remediation beyond rule revert: re-allocation of the 186 orders or slot-window correction to reopen them for carrier confirmation.

next_action.rationale: Root cause mitigated by rule v17 restore, but impact remains: 186 orders stuck in closed slots. Replaying allocation for scope EXC-0921 will re-run them through corrected v17 logic with new booking slots that accommodate carrier confirmation latency. This follows the stale runbook advice (m8_e05) adapted to the evidence: rule revert + re-run allocation for affected orders. This is the remaining reversible action within authorized scope.
